name: notMem_disjointOfDiff
statement: IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) : t ∉ hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht

name: pairwiseDisjoint_insert_disjointOfDiff
statement: IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) : PairwiseDisjoint (insert t (hC.disjointOfDiff hs ht) : Set (Set α)) id

name: exists_disjoint_finset_diff_eq
statement: IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) : ∃ J : Finset (Set α), ↑J ⊆ C ∧ PairwiseDisjoint (J : Set (Set α)) id ∧ s \ ⋃₀ I = ⋃₀ J

name: disjoint_disjointOfDiffUnion
statement: IsSetSemiring C) (hs : s ∈ C) (hI : ↑I ⊆ C) : Disjoint I (hC.disjointOfDiffUnion hs hI)

name: disjointOfUnion_props
statement: IsSetSemiring C) (h1 : ↑J ⊆ C) : ∃ K : Set α → Finset (Set α), PairwiseDisjoint J K ∧ (∀ i ∈ J, ↑(K i) ⊆ C) ∧ PairwiseDisjoint (⋃ x ∈ J, (K x : Set (Set α))) id ∧ (∀ j ∈ J, ⋃₀ K j ⊆ j) ∧ (∀ j ∈ J, ∅ ∉ K j) ∧ ⋃₀ J = ⋃₀ (⋃ x ∈ J, (K x : Set (Set α)))
